bio: This attractive and immaculately kept restaurant is accessed via an inner courtyard. The bright winter garden is a particularly pleasant spot, and has a fireplace for cooler days. In spring and summer, the terrace on the balcony – with a view of the city park and spa gardens – is the place to be. The menu features seasonal and traditional dishes with contemporary, snazzy and on-point presentations. The experienced and friendly service is the icing on the cake....
